claims.claim: Born 12 September 1942 in Vire, about 60 km south of Caen
claims.note: Connexion France states born in Vire, 60 km south of Caen, on September 12, 1942.

claims.claim: July 2026 interview: 64th TV season in September, will be 84
claims.note: Quotes 'ma soixante-quatrième saison de télévision' and 'Je vais avoir 84 ans'.

claims.claim: Sport was his first profession and he still follows it closely
claims.note: 'qui était mon premier métier'.

claims.claim: Career began officially in 1965 in the ORTF sports department
claims.note: 'Sa carrière démarre officiellement en 1965 au service des sports de l'ORTF'.

claims.claim: INA dates his television debut to 1965
claims.note: Archive item refers to his television debut from 1965.

claims.claim: Moved to Paris in early 1960s; Sports Dimanche job with no date
claims.note: 'moved to Paris in the early 1960s'; no date given for the job.

claims.claim: June 2022 interview: Basse-Normandie native, welcomed in Provence, more provincial than Parisian
claims.note: Quotes 'enfant de la Basse-Normandie, accueilli en Provence' and 'plus provincial que parisien'.

claims.claim: Tilt broadcast 5 October 1966
claims.note: Credits of Tilt dated 05/10/1966.

claims.claim: Hosted Les Rendez-vous du dimanche for eight years
claims.note: 'animated for eight years with the program Les Rendez vous du Dimanche'.

claims.claim: Champs-Elysees created 9 January 1982 at Espace Cardin, moved to Studio Gabriel a year later
claims.note: Ozap states both facts.

claims.claim: First Champs-Elysees broadcast 16 January 1982
claims.note: Premiere dated 16/01/1982.

claims.claim: Hosted Champs-Elysees 1982 to 1990 and returned 2010 to 2013
claims.note: 'hosted this variety show from 1982 to 1990 and anchored its return from 2010 to 2013'.

claims.claim: First run lasted eight years; left public service in 1990
claims.note: 'L'aventure dure 8 années'; 'quitte le service public en 1990'.

claims.claim: Given early-evening Saturday prime-time slots on Antenne 2
claims.note: Ozap describes the Saturday prime-time slots.

claims.claim: Vivement dimanche on the Sunday afternoon slot since 1998
claims.note: 'Depuis 1998, Michel a retrouvé la case du dimanche après-midi'.

claims.claim: Show aired on France 2 from 1998 to 2022 and moved to France 3 in August 2022
claims.note: Connexion France states both dates.

claims.claim: 36 years on France 2 before the move
claims.note: 'il a passé 36 ans sur France 2'.

claims.claim: June 2022: moving to a channel that suits him
claims.note: 'Je vais passer sur une chaîne qui me ressemble'.

claims.claim: Show to be more rooted in the provinces (paraphrase)
claims.note: 'plus ancrée vers la province', paraphrased.

claims.claim: July 2026: presenting the show for almost 25 years; it keeps renewing itself
claims.note: Says nearly 25 years and 'nous arrivons à chaque fois à nous renouveler'.

claims.claim: Last Vivement dimanche episode aired 28 June 2026
claims.note: 'Mon dernier Vivement dimanche a été diffusé le 28 juin'.

claims.claim: 3 May 2026: no show, France 3 broadcast a Challenge Cup semi-final (Montpellier vs Dragons)
claims.note: Match named in the article.

claims.claim: Earlier weeks paused for big cycling races, Paris-Roubaix and Liège-Bastogne-Liège
claims.note: Both races named.

claims.claim: No make-up date confirmed
claims.note: 'aucune date précise de retour n'a été confirmée'.

claims.claim: 18 October 2026: France 3 changed schedule for rugby; match not named
claims.note: 'France 3 bouleverse sa programmation habituelle afin de laisser la place au rugby'; match not named.

claims.claim: 1 November 2026: pulled from the schedule, citing Toutelatele, no explicit reason, no return date
claims.note: Attributes to Toutelatele; 'change de stratégie pour ce week-end de la Toussaint'; no return date.

claims.claim: 4 July 2026: Famille je vous aime expected to stop for budget reasons, no end date
claims.note: 'Ça va sans doute s'arrêter pour des raisons budgétaires'; updated 4 July 2026; no end date.

valueNote: Dated career timeline plus the 2026 France 3 Sunday schedule changes, with the source's reason or lack of one stated for each.
summary: All checked claims are supported by the cited sources. Unverified sentences were removed before this verdict.
